title: SSL/TLS Certificates
confirm_letsencrypt: Issuing a Let's Encrypt certificate requires the domain's DNS A record to point to this server. Continue?
issued: Certificate installed ({{tip}}). Expires: {{bitis}}. The site now runs over HTTPS.
confirm_disable: Remove SSL? The site will fall back to HTTP.
disabled: SSL removed. The site is now running over HTTP.
no_ssl: This domain has no active SSL certificate. You can install one below.
self_signed_desc: Generates a self-signed certificate on the server. The browser will show a warning, but the connection is encrypted. Suitable for test/dev environments.
letsencrypt_desc: An official Let's Encrypt certificate, automatically trusted by all browsers. Renews automatically every 90 days.
letsencrypt_warn: ⚠ The domain must point to this server via DNS
